title: Status hub agent activity configuration (agents.yml)
description: Where the hub keeps agent activity, how long, how much of each private field, when a session counts as stuck, who may see the private tier (through the trusted front door) and who may push activity (one bearer token per sender, named by its secret-store reference, never a value). ADR-0013 stage 1b, docs/status.md. Evolve additively.

store.description: The activity database (SQLite), relative to the working directory.

detail.description: Keep the private detail tier at all (false: summary only).

redact_personal_data.description: Also redact personal data (e-mail, phone, card, national id, addresses) from details; secrets are always redacted.

caps.description: Per-field size caps in characters, applied after redaction and before storage.

stuck_after_s.description: A working session with no event for this long is stuck. A model's threshold beats its runtime's, which beats the default.

private.description: The private tier. Absent: never served. Present: served only to requests from a trusted proxy that carry the front door's shared-secret header, an identity header and the viewer group.

service.description: The registry service whose front_door (header + secret reference) the edge adds.

trusted_proxies.description: Registry host names allowed to front the hub; default: the hosts of every edge-proxy service.

detail.description: Accept this sender's private detail tier.

runtimes.description: The runtimes this sender may report (default: any). A sender may only add to sessions it started.

secret_ref.description: A name in the secret store; the value is never in this file.
